Every day, WITI’s group chats buzz with fresh links. As part of our Saturday send for paid readers, we round up 11 of the best.
It’s WITI, on the weekend.
Why are these interesting?
Inside George Nakashima’s Japanese-Style Home & Workshop [ https://substack.com/redirect/4a0adf43-c237-4536-9ef0-3d920628199a?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ] (Architectural Digest)
